Dear Madam
[Bishop Jenner](/person/758) tells me that I should apply to you for permission to use two of [Dr Neale](/person/1078)’s Songs of the Trades in a little [book of poetry](/book/143) for children which I am putting together for Marcus Ward The Songs of the Engine Driver and the Silk Thrower are those that I mean, and I may perhaps also wish to have the Ironfounder, as well as the ballad of Aristomenes[^1] in the Greek history tales.

Hoping that you see no objection to my thus using them, I remain,
yours respectfully

C M Yonge


[^1]: J. M.

Neale, Songs and Ballads for Manufacturers (London: Burns 1846). ‘Aristomenes and the Fox’ was published in J.M.

Neale, Stories from Heathen Mythology and Greek History for the Use of Christian Children (London: Masters 1847).
